incumbent_baselines: core/llm-client.ts (per-family request construction; buffered callText path never declares tools)
codex facts (originator=pi, OpenAI-Beta: responses=experimental, chatgpt-account-id from the JWT claim, /backend-api default, resolveCodexResponsesUrl rule) from the incumbent codex path
identity_rule: C10: the driver mints every identity (model call id, tool call ids); provider response identity fields (id/model) are never read; served_by persisted from the resolved route.

openai-completions.endpoint: {endpoint}/chat/completions (endpoint carries its own /v1 base; trailing slash trimmed; direct concatenation)

request_body.messages: [system?] + user(submission) + per exchange item: assistant{content text|null, tool_calls[{id, type:function, function{name, arguments JSON-string}}]} / tool{tool_call_id, content}
request_body.stream_modes: buffered (stream:false, production dispatch) / streaming (stream:true + stream_options.include_usage:true; T04-ready path, golden-pinned)

openai-completions.history_render: text blocks joined with \n; the turn's Reasoning blocks materialize as the assistant message's reasoning_content field (the DeepSeek/Kimi/MiMo/Zhipu carrier, R05 RR1 F08) — the compat replay policy then keeps it (declared reasoning_content contract), refuses without it (require-tool-call) or strips it (no contract / thinking off); a reasoning-only turn emits no message of its own; provider-opaque blocks have no input shape and are not echoed (durable in the exchange, never re-sent); resource refs render as [resource: <uri>] text lines; tool results render via the shared four-state vocabulary
openai-completions.response_parse: choices[0].message; content string | parts array | null (parts keep order: text/output_text->Text, reasoning/thinking->Reasoning, unknown->Opaque verbatim, C06); tool_calls -> ToolRequests (name->target via the send-time snapshot only; arguments string-or-object, validated); zero choices / missing message = loud invalid_message; no content and no calls = Empty(finish_reason)
openai-completions.usage: usage.prompt_tokens + usage.completion_tokens, both-or-never (a half-reported usage is no usage)
openai-completions.streaming: SSE data: frames; delta.content / delta.reasoning_content concatenated; delta.tool_calls fragments keyed by index (id/name from the first fragment, arguments concatenated); terminal usage chunk; [DONE] sentinel REQUIRED (absent = truncated, loud); choice index != 0 is loud; the aggregate is re-validated by the SAME buffered parser
openai-completions.opaque_policy: unknown content parts round-trip as Opaque{provider:openai-completions} in the exchange; they are never echoed back onto this wire

anthropic-messages.endpoint: append_provider_api_path(endpoint, "/v1/messages") (the incumbent join rule: /v1 dedup, case-insensitive path-suffix match)

request_body.max_tokens: REQUIRED by the family; pinned constant 16384 (DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS) — the per-call budget field is a REGISTERED CONTRACT GAP owned by R05-T05/T07
request_body.messages: user(submission string) + assistant{content blocks} + user{tool_result blocks}

anthropic-messages.history_render: assistant content blocks in order: Text->text; Reasoning+adjacent thinking_signature Opaque->thinking block with signature (C10 recombination); a thinking_signature Opaque with NO preceding Reasoning is the signed EMPTY-thinking shape — reconstructed in place as {type:thinking, thinking:"", signature} (R05 RR1 F06, never dropped); redacted_thinking Opaque->verbatim block; unsigned Reasoning and other-family Opaque are never echoed; tool_use blocks appended after content (the registered C06 normalization); consecutive ToolResults of one turn MERGE into ONE user message of tool_result blocks (the family pairing rule), is_error = outcome is not Success; family Opaque state is source-bound: the turn's recorded origin (provider+model) must match the request's route or the render refuses loudly (R05 RR1 F09)
anthropic-messages.response_parse: content blocks: text->Text; thinking->Reasoning + adjacent Opaque thinking_signature (the signature is state, never text); redacted_thinking and every unknown block type->Opaque verbatim; tool_use->ToolRequest (id pairing); stop_reason reaches the Empty detail
anthropic-messages.streaming: the family speaks SSE in production (message_start / content_block_* / message_delta vocabulary); T03 pins the BUFFERED contract only — the SSE vocabulary is registered here, incremental decode lands with T04
anthropic-messages.opaque_policy: Opaque{provider:anthropic-messages}: thinking_signature and redacted_thinking; recombined/verbatim on the way out; never crossed to another family
evidence: models/anthropic_messages.rs unit tests (C10 round-trip, cross-family non-echo)

google-generative-ai.endpoint: append_provider_api_path(endpoint, "/models/{model}:generateContent") with the model id percent-encoded (RFC 3986 unreserved pass-through; a configured model id can never smuggle path/query syntax)
google-generative-ai.history_render: model parts IN ORIGINAL PART ORDER: Text->text part; Reasoning->{text, thought:true}; a thoughtSignature Opaque re-attaches to the SAME part it signed (C10); functionCall parts are POSITION-ANCHORED by the parse (functionCallPart opaque in content) so each call — with its part thoughtSignature when it carried one (R05 RR1 F07) — re-renders at its original position as functionCall{name, args OBJECT (never a string), id? when the provider issued one}; id-less calls and anchor-less exchanges keep the content-first order; other-family Opaque never echoed; family-owned unknown Opaque verbatim (incl. the empty-text signed part); ToolResults of ONE tool round MERGE into ONE user content of functionResponse parts (the official Gemini parallel grouping, R05 RR1 F07), name resolved through the exchange's tool_call_id -> wire-name chain (an unpairable result is a loud render failure, never a guess), response{status: succeeded|failed|cancelled|unknown, content: shared four-state text}, id? round-tripped
google-generative-ai.response_parse: candidates[0].content.parts: functionCall->ToolRequest (args object; id optional); text+thought:true->Reasoning; text->Text; thoughtSignature->adjacent Opaque; unknown part->Opaque verbatim; finishReason reaches the Empty detail
google-generative-ai.usage: usageMetadata.promptTokenCount + candidatesTokenCount, both-or-never; thoughtsTokenCount is NEVER folded in
google-generative-ai.streaming: :streamGenerateContent?alt=sse vocabulary registered; T03 pins the BUFFERED contract only (T04)
google-generative-ai.opaque_policy: Opaque{provider:google-generative-ai}: thoughtSignature + unknown parts; re-attached/verbatim on the way out

request_body.instructions: the host system prompt; absent when unresolved
request_body.input: message{role:user, content:[input_text]} + per exchange item IN ORIGINAL RELATIVE ORDER (R05 RR1 F10: no re-sorting into a fixed standard order): family reasoning Opaque re-inserted VERBATIM at its position (C10) / assistant message{content:[output_text]} (adjacent text segments join \n) / function_call{call_id, name, arguments JSON-string} at its anchored position (function_call_item anchor) or, for anchor-less exchanges, after the content / function_call_output{call_id, output}
request_body.server_state: C11: NO store key, NO previous_response_id — never a server-side session reference

openai-responses.response_parse: output items: message(content: output_text->Text; refusal/unknown parts->Opaque, never answer text); reasoning->summary texts as Reasoning + the WHOLE item as Opaque (encrypted_content preserved); function_call->ToolRequest (call_id pairing); every other item type->Opaque verbatim; status:failed -> honest Failed turn (upstream_unavailable, non-retryable, provider error text); status:incomplete -> Empty with the reason
openai-responses.streaming: SSE frames; ONLY the terminal response.completed/failed/incomplete event's response object is authoritative (handed to the SAME buffered parser); response error events are loud; a stream without a terminal event is truncated-loud, never half-parsed; delta/progress events are the T04 incremental vocabulary
openai-responses.opaque_policy: Opaque{provider:openai-responses}: reasoning items (encrypted_content) + refusal parts + unknown item types + function_call_item position anchors; all family Opaque is source-bound to the minting provider/model (R05 RR1 F09)

openai-codex-responses.endpoint: resolve_codex_responses_url(endpoint): trailing slashes trimmed; a path already ending /codex/responses is used as-is; otherwise /codex/responses is appended (production default endpoint https://chatgpt.com/backend-api — the config carries the endpoint explicitly, no silent default)

auth_headers.oauth_only: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth JWT> — any other credential shape is a loud non-retryable Unauthorized BEFORE any request
fixed: chatgpt-account-id: <JWT claim https://api.openai.com/auth.chatgpt_account_id> — a missing/unparseable claim is a loud non-retryable Unauthorized, never a fabricated id

request_body.instructions: the host system prompt when resolved, otherwise the incumbent constant DEFAULT_CODEX_INSTRUCTIONS
request_body.input: the SHARED openai-responses input-item rendering (family tag openai-codex-responses for opaque state)

openai-codex-responses.response_parse: always the shared responses SSE stream parse (terminal event authoritative) with the codex family tag
openai-codex-responses.streaming: SSE is the ONLY wire mode of this family
openai-codex-responses.opaque_policy: Opaque{provider:openai-codex-responses}: reasoning items + refusal parts + unknown item types; never crossed with the plain openai-responses tag
evidence: models/openai_codex_responses.rs unit tests (URL rule, JWT claim)

volcengine-bigasr.status: RESOLVED-BUT-UNIMPLEMENTED: ProtocolNotImplemented at the dispatch boundary, BEFORE any request leaves the process (r05_t01_model_plane c06 pins stub.hits()==0); owned by R05-T06

system-speech.status: RESOLVED-BUT-UNIMPLEMENTED: same loud-refusal boundary; owned by R05-T06

vocabulary.success: content blocks (non-text as their JSON) + [resource: name <uri>] lines + process status line + truncation marker LAST ("\n[result truncated at the tool's bound]")
vocabulary.cancelled: tool call cancelled by the host before completion
vocabulary.unknown: tool outcome could not be determined: <reason>

tool_outcome_rendering.owner: models/tool_render.rs — ONE vocabulary shared by every family (C07/C08)

error_classification.401: unauthorized, non-retryable (the caller's single bounded refresh-and-retry applies)
error_classification.3xx: upstream_unavailable, non-retryable — redirects are NEVER followed with credential-bearing requests and the Location target is never echoed (C10)
error_classification.scrubbing: the provider error body is attacker-influenceable echo: the excerpt is truncated to 512 chars and scrubbed of every in-play credential material before it travels (C09)
error_classification.owner: models/dispatch.rs classify_error_status — one table, verbatim across families

shared.transport: no-redirect reqwest client; one POST per turn; SSE decoding through models/streaming.rs SseDecoder (8 MiB bound, CR/LF/CRLF, BOM, multi-line data:, comment lines skipped, id:/retry: intentionally ignored, strict UTF-8, a partial trailing frame is discarded and reported). R05-T05: three-segment timeout discipline (connect 10s / first-byte 30s / per-call total budget 300s shared across queue wait + credential refresh + backoff + network + streaming; idle-stream 60s at the driver's delta drain); proxy auto-detection disabled (incumbent parity — Node fetch never consults ambient proxies; an ambient proxy breaks the A10 acceptance proof and sees credential material); Retry-After (both RFC 9110 forms) rides error details.retryAfterMs on 429; retry classes = 429/5xx bounded (driver backoff base*2^(n-1) capped, hint override, deadline veto, cancel-aware sleep), connect-phase failures (provably never accepted); every post-acceptance failure (send/head/mid-stream/408) NON-retryable — no blind resend (A10).
shared.streaming_scope_decision: production dispatch is BUFFERED for openai-completions/anthropic-messages/google-generative-ai/openai-responses; the streaming DECODE path is implemented and golden-pinned for openai-completions (execute_chat_streaming) and is the only mode for openai-codex-responses; anthropic/google SSE vocabularies are registered here and land with T04's incremental delivery
shared.incumbent_tool_gap: the incumbent buffered callText path NEVER declared tools; every family's tool wire shape in this matrix is the protocol-standard shape pinned by the T03 goldens (recorded as a baseline fact, not a regression)
contract_gaps: anthropic max_tokens pinned constant 16384 (per-call budget is not part of ModelTurnInput; R05-T07 owns it)
ModelTurnInput.system_prompt is None from the host today (persona wiring is a later stage; codex falls back to its documented constant)
proxy/TLS configuration surface (system/manual/direct/NO_PROXY, private-CA pinning) deferred — transport is direct-only by T05 decision (see R05_INTERFACE_EVOLUTION.md §25 decision 6)
